changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 5 item 13: added writeFileAtomic(path, data, { mode? }) to fs.ts, the overwrite-and-replace counterpart to the existing create-only publishFileExclusive (same sibling-temp-file-then-swap shape, but rename() over an existing target instead of link() refusing one). TransactionalStore now calls it instead of its own inline write-tmp-then-rename sequence.
